drinks.name: Coors Light - 12 oz
drinks.description: Light, lager beer, known for its crisp, clean and refreshing taste.
drinks.extended_description: Contains lightly toasted two-row barley, selected hops from around the world, Coors' cherished yeast strain, maize and water. With subtle kettle hop character, mild maltiness and fresh fruity notes of green apple and banana.

drinks.name: Corona Premier - 12 oz - Low Carb
drinks.description: Premium, light lager beer from Mexico
drinks.extended_description: Corona Premier is a smooth, low-carb Mexican light lager with 90 calories, 2.6 grams of carbohydrates, and a 4% alcohol-by-volume (ABV) per 12 oz serving. It delivers a crisp, clean, and dry finish with subtle malt sweetness and low bitterness.

drinks.name: Modelo Especial - 12 oz
drinks.description: Mexican Pilsner-style lager known for its crisp, refreshing taste and well-balanced flavor.
drinks.extended_description: A benchmark of our deep brewing heritage, this rich, full-flavored Pilsner-style Mexican lager showcases our commitment to quality in every pour. Well-balanced taste and light hop character with a crisp finish. Characterized by an orange blossom honey aroma with a hint of herb. Contains water, barley malt, non-malted cereals, and hops

drinks.name: Pilot Puck Off Pilsner
drinks.description: A pale, crisp and refreshing lager, with a neutral malt flavor and noticeable hop bitterness.
drinks.extended_description: Puck Off Pilsner is a 5.5% ABV pale, crisp, and refreshing lager brewed by Pilot Brewing in Charlotte, North Carolina. Crafted as the official hockey season beer for the Charlotte Checkers, it features a neutral malt backbone, noticeable hop bitterness, 32 IBUs, and a gluten-reduced recipe.

drinks.name: Hazy Little Thing IPA - 12 oz
drinks.description: IPA known for its juicy, fruit-forward flavors and smooth, silky mouthfeel.
drinks.extended_description: Sierra Nevada brews Hazy Little Thing with the finest ingredients for the purest quality in every sip.  Brewed to be juicy, but not sweet. Hoppy, but not bitter. Velvety smooth and handcrafted with Citra and Mosaic hops.

drinks.name: Cavit Pinot Noir - 187 ml
drinks.description: Bright cherry, strawberry, and red raspberry. Light-to-medium body with soft, gentle tannins
drinks.extended_description:
A youthful, vibrant purple. Delicate and alluring aromas of black cherry. Silky smooth with well defined fruit redolent of red berries and cherries; medium-bodied with soft tannins, concluding in a stylish finish. Pairs well with grilled or roasted red meats, poultry, flavorful vegetarian entrees, risottos. Enjoy with fish such as salmon, tuna and swordfish.
Planet Grape: 91
Wine Enthusiasts: 89

drinks.name: Conundrum Red Blend - 375 ml
drinks.description: Dark plum, cherry, cocoa powder, and toasted oak.
drinks.extended_description:
A rich, dark red, it offers aromas of ripe berries & plums, warmed by a hint of cocoa. Dried fruit & the taste of chocolate-covered cherries come through on the palate, while a wisp of smokiness makes this wine – created from dark red varietals including Zinfandel & Petite Sirah – the perfect complement to grilled meats & full-flavored dishes. Tannins are rounded out by the ripeness of the berries for a texturous but smooth mouth feel. The finish makes us think of lingering at the end of a long evening & still not wanting to go home, with layers of rich flavor that teasingly trail off.
Wine Spectator: 90 
Wine Enthusiast: 91

drinks.name: Line 39 Cabernet Sauvignon - 375 ml
drinks.description: Bold aromas of dark berry fruit, vanilla spice, and hints of black tea or cola.
drinks.extended_description:
A smooth, medium-full Cabernet Sauvignon with inviting aromas of blackberry, plum, and currant. plus subtle hints of black tea. On the palate, rich dark fruit flavors blend with a touch of cocoa, all wrapped up in soft tannins for an easy, satisfying finish.
Wine Spectator: 92
Wine Enthusiast: 92

drinks.name: Bonanza Chardonnay - 375 ml
drinks.description: Fruit-forward California white emphasizing crisp melon, fresh floral aromas, and vibrant acidity
drinks.extended_description:
Nose: Aromas of light melon, fresh white flowers, green apple, and crisp pear with subtle citrus and vanilla hints.  Palate: Medium-bodied with flavors of ripe peach, tropical fruit, and lemon curd, rounded out by a clean, vibrant acidity.  Finish: Smooth, crisp, and refreshing with a clean, lingering citrus-zest close.  
Wine Spectator: 90 
Wine Enthusiast: 88

drinks.name: Cavit Pinot Grigio - 187 ml
drinks.description: Light refreshing flavors of citrus and green apple
drinks.extended_description:
Bright straw gold color. On the nose is delicate and pleasing with floral and fruit scents. The palate is dry, light and crisp. A wonderful aperitif and equally splendid with pasta in cream sauces, risottos, veal, chicken and fresh dishes. 
Wine Enthusiast: 87
Wine Spectator: 88

drinks.name: Honig Sauvignon Blanc - 375 ml
drinks.description: Honig Sauvignon Blanc is a crisp, dry white wine primarily sourced from California’s Napa Valley and Lake County
drinks.extended_description:
Zesty and vibrant with aromas of grapefruit, lime, green apples and fresh herbs. Light-bodied and crisp, with bright acidity and a clean, citrusy finish. Bright and mouthwatering, offering lemon-lime flavors, with lemongrass and lemon blossom accents, plus touches of lemon balm and basil.  
Wine Enthusiast: 93
Wine Spectator: 89

drinks.name: Imagery Chardonnay - 750 ml
drinks.description: Subtle oak and balanced flavors of green apple and vanilla, followed by complex layers of fruit and spice.
drinks.extended_description:
Crisp and elegant, this Chardonnay radiates aromas of apple, lime and pear. Subtle oak and and a touch of Chenin Blanc, boost this wine’s brightness and overall liveliness. Balanced flavors of green apple and vanilla, followed by complex layers of fruit and spice lead to an elegant creamy finish. Natural varietal characteristics of Chardonnay shine through without being overshadowed by dominant oak notes. 
Wine Enthusiast: 89 
Wine Spectator: 92

drinks.name: Lunetta Prosecco Brut - 187 ml
drinks.description: Refreshing, dry, and harmonious, with crisp fruit flavors and a clean finish.
drinks.extended_description:
Indulge in the lively flavors of Lunetta Prosecco, a sparkling wine made from the best grapes in Veneto, Italy. This wine has rich fruit flavors, balanced acidity, and a touch of subtle oak. Its refreshing taste makes it perfect for celebrations, casual gatherings, or a quiet night at home. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or just relaxing, Lunetta Prosecco adds a bit of Italian style to your glass. Enjoy the charm of Veneto with every sip. 
Wine Enthusiast: 93
Wine Spectator: 86

drinks.name: Segura Viudas Cava Brut - 187 ml
drinks.description: Aromas are of white fruits, citrus and tropical fruits, and light floral notes
drinks.extended_description:
Segura Viudas’ entry level Cava, the Non-Vintage Brut Reserva offers up a pleasant perfume of yeast notes, biscuit, and green apple. It is a straightforward, lively, slightly off-dry bubbly.  Standard lemon-lime aromas open this quaffable Cava. In the mouth, it’s creamy and soft but not mushy, with candied mango, papaya and vanilla flavors that finish sweet. 
Wine Enthusiast: 86
Wine Spectator: 89

drinks.name: Segura Viudas Cava Rosé - 187 ml
drinks.description: Youthful fruit aromas of strawberry, redcurrant and grenadine.
drinks.extended_description:
Discover the elegance of Segura Viudas Brut Rosé, a remarkable sparkling wine crafted from the best grapes in Spain. This wine has rich fruit flavors, balanced acidity, and a touch of oak. It's perfect for celebrations or casual gatherings. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or enjoying a quiet evening, Segura Viudas Brut Rosé offers a refreshing and satisfying experience. Enjoy the perfect mix of tradition and taste with every sip.
Wine Spectator: 86
Wine Enthusiast: 87

drinks.name: Segura Viudas Cava Rosé - 750 ml
drinks.description: Youthful fruit aromas of strawberry, redcurrant and grenadine.
drinks.extended_description:
Discover the elegance of Segura Viudas Brut Rosé, a remarkable sparkling wine crafted from the best grapes in Spain. This wine has rich fruit flavors, balanced acidity, and a touch of oak. It's perfect for celebrations or casual gatherings. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or enjoying a quiet evening, Segura Viudas Brut Rosé offers a refreshing and satisfying experience. Enjoy the perfect mix of tradition and taste with every sip.
Wine Spectator: 86
Wine Enthusiast: 87

drinks.name: Blake's Original Apple Cider
drinks.description: The original play on what we think a tasty apple cider should be, uncomplicated, slightly sweet, crisp and clean with ripe apple aroma.
drinks.extended_description: Blake's Hard Cider describes its Original Classic Apple as an uncomplicated, slightly sweet, crisp, and clean hard cider with a ripe apple aroma. It is an easy-drinking, sessionable 5.5% ABV classic made with 100% fresh-pressed apples.

drinks.name: Blake's Triple Jam
drinks.description: Bursting with strawberries, blackberries, and raspberries, this semi-sweet captivates the nuance of our farm, in each and every taste.
drinks.extended_description: is a semi-sweet, gluten-free hard cider crafted by Blake's Hard Cider Co. in Armada, Michigan. It features a 6.5% ABV and a vibrant three-berry flavor profile packed with real strawberries, blackberries, and raspberries.

drinks.name: Flatrock Tropical Pineapple - 16 oz
drinks.description: Fruity apple aroma is paired with a refershing and clean pineapple finish.
drinks.extended_description: Flat Rock Tropical Pineapple Cider is a gluten-free hard cider crafted by Flat Rock Cider Company in North Carolina. It features a local culinary apple base blended with real pineapple added during the final mixing stages, delivering a 6.0% ABV drink with a fruity aroma and clean finish.

drinks.name: Truly Strawberry Lemonade - 12 oz
drinks.description: Blend of sweet strawberry lemonade and refreshing hard seltzer.
drinks.extended_description: Truly Strawberry Lemonade is a popular hard seltzer flavor from Truly Hard Seltzer that blends sweet lemonade, juicy strawberry flavor, and clean hard seltzer. Each standard 12-ounce can contains 5% ABV, 100 calories, 1 gram of sugar, and 3 grams of carbohydrates, and the drink is gluten-free.

drinks.name: Truly Wild Berry - 12 oz
drinks.description: Real fruit flavor and a whole lotta berry refreshment!
drinks.extended_description: Wild berry is a popular, best-selling 5% ABV hard seltzer featuring a sweet blend of strawberry, raspberry, and blackberry flavors. Each standard 12-ounce serving contains 100 calories, 1 gram of sugar, and is gluten-free.

drinks.name: Water - 16.9 oz
drinks.description: Just water!

drinks.name: Coke - 12 oz
drinks.description: The authentic, crisp, and refreshing cola taste you love, served ice-cold with a familiar, bubbly fizz.
drinks.extended_description:
Sweet and sugary: Driven by a rich base of caramelized sugar or high-fructose corn syrup.
Spicy and warm notes: Features distinct undertones of vanilla, cinnamon, and nutmeg.
Citrus brightness: Includes subtle hints of lemon, orange, or lime oils that add a slight tang.
Fizzy texture: Delivers a sharp, bubbly pop and effervescent mouthfeel from carbon.

drinks.name: Sprite - 12 oz
drinks.description: Bright, zesty lemon-lime. 100% caffeine-free, crisp carbonation, and a clean finish
drinks.extended_description: Sprite is a crisp, refreshing, caffeine-free lemon-lime soft drink with a clean, tangy citrus taste. Served ice-cold, it delivers ultimate refreshment with natural lemon and lime flavors. It is the perfect sweet and fizzy beverage to pair with any meal or combo.

drinks.name: Diet Coke - 12 oz
drinks.description: Crisp, refreshing, and zero-calorie cola with that unmistakable, lighter Diet Coke fizz.
drinks.extended_description: Diet Coke is a popular sugar-free, low-calorie carbonated soft drink introduced by The Coca-Cola Company in 1982. It features zero sugar, zero calories, and a unique, lighter flavor profile with a crisp bite driven by artificial sweeteners like aspartame
